statement_details.original_statement: CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufnCalculateCustomerLifetimeValue](@CustomerID INT) RETURNS DECIMAL(10, 2) AS BEGIN DECLARE @TotalSpent DECIMAL(10, 2); DECLARE @FirstOrderDate DATE; DECLARE @DaysSinceFirstOrder INT; DECLARE @LifetimeValue DECIMAL(10, 2); SELECT @TotalSpent = SUM([TotalAmount]), @FirstOrderDate = MIN([OrderDate]) FROM [dbo].[Shopping] WHERE [CustomerID] = @CustomerID AND TRIM([Status]) != 'Refund Requested'; SET @DaysSinceFirstOrder = DATEDIFF(DAY, @FirstOrderDate, GETDATE()); IF @DaysSinceFirstOrder = 0 SET @LifetimeValue = @TotalSpent; ELSE SET @LifetimeValue = (@TotalSpent / @DaysSinceFirstOrder) * 365.25; RETURN @LifetimeValue; END;
